# P3 engine dry run: which of the study's cells can the shipped engine predict? (step 16e)

*Generated by `scripts/generators/build_p3_engine_dry_run.py` (STATUS_AND_PLAN step 16e; `docs/guides/FACTORIAL_LEVER_STUDY.md`, 'Premortem'). The shipped engine on the 8 corners of the P3 design through its own front door; A4 main effects. A design diagnostic: it changes no constant, ships nothing and reads no study data.*

**Result.** In 15 % pea isolate (protein sites only, the placeholder composition), the engine predicts **3 of 57** lever x odorant cells (all 4 matched pairs), and 10 more in part. 126 integrations.

| reading | cells | predicted | partial | sugar identity | sulfur source | pH | main reasons not predicted |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| pea_isolate | 57 | 3 | 10 | 1 | 1 | 1 | the engine refuses the ratio (48 pairs); no engine target for this odorant (21 pairs); the engine refuses the arm (15 pairs) |
| pea_isolate_ph_held | 57 | 6 | 15 | 2 | 2 | 2 | the engine refuses the ratio (23 pairs); no engine target for this odorant (21 pairs); the engine refuses the arm (15 pairs) |
| added_precursors | 57 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | the engine refuses the ratio (44 pairs); no engine target for this odorant (21 pairs); the engine refuses the arm (15 pairs) |

Readings: `pea_isolate` = 15 % pea isolate via `src/ingredients.py`, no buffer salt; `pea_isolate_ph_held` = the same, pH held at the set value; `added_precursors` = the added sugar and sulfur source in water. 'Reasons' count matched pairs, not cells.
